digest.component_or_area: Mypy type checking configuration and ratchet
propositions: Enable four safe Mypy strictness flags globally (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) while deferring disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs.
A redundant int cast exists at editor.py:515 that must be removed after verification in the pinned canonical CI environment.
Twenty-six unused-ignore diagnostics across 22 files must be resolved by removal, narrowing, or preservation with documentation, contingent on full project extras provisioning.
mypy src/rebar --warn-redundant-casts must exit 0 after removing the diagnosed cast at editor.py:515.
mypy src/rebar --warn-unused-ignores must exit 0 after addressing all 26 baseline unused-ignore suppressions.
All type-related and behavior-adjacent tests must pass after enabling the four strictness flags.
